description:
Optional ImageIO reader backed by libvips via Project Panama.
        Adds cross-platform support (macOS, Linux, Windows) for HEIC, AVIF, WebP,
        JPEG 2000, PDF, SVG, EXR, FITS, and more. Requires libvips installed on
        the system. Not included in the imageio-native aggregator — add this
        dependency explicitly to opt in.
